title: dianthus fruticosus subsp. rhodius
intro: Dianthus fruticosus subsp. rhodius, commonly known as the Rock Pink or Alpine Pink, is a flowering plant that belongs to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Dianthus fruticosus subsp. rhodius, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, are responsible for its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects. The plant's therapeutic actions suggest its potential use in treating various health conditions, including wounds, gastrointestinal disorders, and respiratory issues.
